::: {.pagelead}
With 10+ years of engineering experience, I take AI products from first prototype to production and paying customers, and I have been the first engineer on new products several times. At Bosch I set the architecture of a multi-agent platform and built its core agent. As Novee's first engineer I built three LLM products, and all were sold. At Peppy I led the AI of an employee-benefits platform that was sold to enterprise clients and spun out as Euphoric. Earlier, I was the founding engineer of Supersense, an assistive app for blind users, and co-founded an ed-tech startup. Alongside engineering, I am doing a PhD on language models that learn from experience, and my open 27B document agent was a joint winner of the ICDAR 2026 DocVQA challenge.
:::

## Experience

::: {.cvrole}
[Staff AI Engineer — Independent Contractor]{.rh}
[Mar 2025 – present · remote]{.rmeta}


**Bosch Legends Lab** — multi-agent platform for sourcing external experts · Jan 2026 – present

- Architected a greenfield multi-agent platform around durable workflow execution and event-driven services, so agents run for hours at scale, survive failures and resume where they stopped, a design that **held up where general-purpose agent harnesses stalled on long tasks**.
- Consolidated the platform's early microservices into a monolith until service boundaries were clear, which let a small team ship its first use cases quickly, then split it into services behind a gateway.
- Built the core agent, a neuro-symbolic research agent that finds experts across the web and assesses them against a project's criteria, in runs of hours over up to ten thousand candidates. It **outperforms other deep-research tools by a large margin** on our benchmarks, and recruiters prefer it to their previous tools.
- **Set up the new team's engineering culture**: RFCs for design decisions, CI/CD, API and observability standards, a roadmap of small milestone releases shaped with the PM and business manager, shared coding-agent workflows, and evaluation-driven agent development.


**Novee AI** — LLM products for insurance underwriting · May 2025 – Dec 2025

*First engineer hired; worked directly with the CTO.*

- Built an LLM extraction product, delivered on a tight deadline, that **won Novee a client contract**: an ensemble of agents that pulls insured assets from messy PDFs, spreadsheets and email threads and reliably automates whole categories of submissions.
- **Built evaluation from day one** and, with the PM and labeling team, fixed unreliable labels and product assumptions before optimising, so every design choice was decided by data.
- Built a superhuman contract-comparison agent that **caught material changes that underwriters missed**. The labeling interface I built for its evaluation shipped to clients as the product's interface.
- Designed self-correcting extraction agents that check their output against independent evidence in the documents and fix what fails, improving reliability substantially; other engineers reused the approach in other products.

:::
